summary: Iteration 16: Verified auth speed-pass + bcrypt rehash, brute-force lockout, admin/customer portal separation, change-password roundtrip, IFSC lookup (Razorpay + Mongo cache) with UI display on /profile. 13/13 pytest tests passed. Frontend flows validated end-to-end.

issues: DOB uses browser default date picker (<input type='date'>) instead of shadcn calendar — noted from prior iterations, not new

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2212 lines — recommend splitting (auth, kyc, admin, ifsc) into modules; exceeds 700-line guideline.
lookup_ifsc_info swallows all httpx errors uniformly — logging razorpay 5xx would help ops.
change_password endpoint does not enforce that new_password != current_password.
IfscBankInfo debounce (350ms) is fine but does not cancel in-flight API call on unmount — minor.

test_results_detail.backend: 13/13 passed (5.9s). Login latency measured ~341ms first call, ~200-260ms subsequent. Stored hash after first successful login confirmed $2b$10$ prefix (rehash working).

frontend.admin_login_submit_to_dashboard_ms: ≈2530 (includes networkidle wait; actual render <1s based on visual)

test_results_detail.lockout_flow: After 5 wrong pw -> 429 lock; delete login_attempts doc unlocks; verified

seed_data_creation: None — passwords restored to original at end of change_password roundtrip test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 16 features validated. IFSC cache populated for SBIN0005943 and MAHG0004001 (30-day TTL). Login latency for customer is ~250-350ms — the parallel gather + bcrypt-in-thread optimization is effective. Bcrypt rehash to rounds=10 confirmed on stored hash.
